title: Fibre Betti numbers of a descended line bundle
statement: Let \(f:X\to S\) be flat, proper and locally finitely presented [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Assume its tensor-pullback structure-module adjunction unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] is an isomorphism after every base change. Let \(L\) be invertible on \(X\) [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let \(k:W\to S\) be an immersion (a morphism factoring as a closed immersion followed by an open immersion), \(w\in W\), \(s\in S\), and \(k(w)=s\). Assume \(L_s\cong f_s^*N\) for a finite locally free module \(N\) on \(\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\) [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module, def-weil-residue-field], using tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Fix derived-category localizations for every scheme [def-pc-derived-category], and put \(E=R(f_W)_*(L_W[0])\) [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Then \(\beta_j(E,w)=0\) for every \(j<0\), and \(\beta_0(E,w)=1\), with the derived fibre Betti numbers of [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti]. No model or target trivialization is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_directImage_fibre_betti
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S),
      IsIso ((Classical.choose
        (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)))
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) [IsImmersion k]
    (w : W) (s : S) (hw : k w = s)
    (hLs : ∃ (N : (Spec (S.residueField s)).Modules) (_ : N.IsFiniteLocallyFree),
      Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj L ≅
        (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.snd f (S.fromSpecResidueField s))).obj N)) :
    let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
    (∀ j : ℤ, j < 0 → derivedFiberBetti W E j w = 0) ∧
      derivedFiberBetti W E 0 w = 1
